### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                          |
| ----- | ------ | -------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | speech, word                     |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to say, talk, speak, yap         |
| ~a    | *psv.* | said, spoken                     |
| ~an   | *adj.* | verbal, communicative, talkative |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
mouth ([[Sen'fi/Glossary/Body parts/han\|han]]) + emitter -> 曰, 言, sitelen pona "toki"
